reason: Fasting blood glucose of diabetic mice fed different steamed-bread diets over weeks 7–11; an in vivo feeding outcome, not a processing effect on a target in a food.
foods: steamed multigrain bread from LAB-fermented dough (FMSB), steamed multigrain bread without LAB (MSB), steamed wheat-flour bread (WSB); fed to mice at 30% of diet
treatments: multigrain dough fermented with LAB for 24 h at 37 °C (85% RH), yeast + baking soda 30 min, proofed 20 min at 37 °C, steamed over boiling water for 25 min; diets of 30% steamed bread + 70% basal diet for five weeks
methods_quote: The dough was then placed in a steamer over boiling water and steamed for 25 min to produce steamed bread.
